name: Kanto + Johto Six Starters
description: Choose Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile from a six-choice menu at any Poké Ball in Professor Elm's lab. Preview and confirm one level-5 partner holding a Berry. The rival uses the original Johto starter that counters your chosen type. Original world, story, graphics, and music remain.
notes: Start a new game to choose a starter. B cancels the menu. Experimental: full playthrough and cross-version save compatibility are unverified. Keep existing saves on their original patch version.
